mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_space_permission_table (space_id, user_id, target_node_id, can_read, can_write, can_delete, can_share, can_invite, can_manage, granted_by) VALUES (#{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{targetNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{canRead}, #{canWrite}, #{canDelete}, #{canShare}, #{canInvite}, #{canManage}, #{grantedBy,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE can_read = VALUES(can_read), can_write = VALUES(can_write), can_delete = VALUES(can_delete), can_share = VALUES(can_share), can_invite = VALUES(can_invite), can_manage = VALUES(can_manage), granted_by = VALUES(granted_by), granted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
